# Search Auto

> Operators since 2004 who have sold auto parts, not a typical agency. Shopify fitment, PIM, migrations, and managed marketing for automotive aftermarket retailers.

Search Auto is an automotive aftermarket eCommerce company run by merchants. Stuart and Joey started working together in 2009 and grew a running-board and tonneau-cover business to $250M that became part of RealTruck through its acquisition by Truck Hero in 2015. Brands include Ionic Automotive, Gator Covers, and Havoc Offroad. It builds and runs tools for auto parts and accessories retailers on Shopify: a fitment lookup app (Year/Make/Model search), a PIM for catalog and ACES/PIES fitment data, platform migrations, integrations, and digital marketing.
